# mGBA, vendored

`core/` is the part of mGBA the engine builds, its Game Boy core, taken from the commit pinned in `config/mgba.json` (commit, date, archive and its SHA-256, SHA-256 of the vendored `core/` tree): the sources of the Game Boy core, of its SM83 processor, of mGBA's core layer and of the utilities they call, inih (which reads the core's configuration), the template of the version file, and their headers. Neither the GBA core, nor the debugger, scripting, threads, files on disk or any external library. `tools/vendor_mgba.py` lists those files; `third_party/CMakeLists.txt` compiles every source of the tree (and one of the two platform files). `LICENSE` is mGBA's licence, the Mozilla Public License 2.0; inih's, the BSD 3-Clause licence, is `core/src/third-party/inih/LICENSE.txt`. `NOTICE.txt` says where the source of what the binaries carry is; the three files and `boot-rom.patch` (the change, in source form, as the Mozilla Public License asks of a binary) go beside every binary and in the Android application's licences.

One change is made, `boot-rom.patch`: one line that adds the CRC32 of the free CGB boot ROM the engine embeds for mGBA (`engine/core/cgb_boot_rom_mgba.c`, `0xf078299a`: SameBoy's, its logo reading MGBA, derived by `engine/core/gen_boot_rom_mgba.py`) to the boot ROMs `GBIsCompatibleBIOS` accepts, without which mGBA's reset drops it and starts the cartridge without a boot ROM. mGBA also drops a boot ROM it does not know when it detects the model itself (`GBDetectModel`): the model is given to it, a CGB, as SameBoy's is (`tests/test_mgba_boot.c`). The patched file is under the MPL like the rest, and published with it.

Nothing else in `core/` is edited: `tools/audit_tracked_files.py` recomputes the tree hash and fails when it differs from `config/mgba.json`.

To update: change the commit, the date, the archive's URL and SHA-256 in `config/mgba.json`, run `python3 tools/vendor_mgba.py` (it downloads the archive, checks it, replaces `core/` and `LICENSE`, applies the patch, which must still apply, and prints the new tree hash), write that hash into `config/mgba.json`, update the commit in `NOTICE.txt` (twice), and run `tests/test_mgba_boot.c` with the other tests without ROM; the code that reads mGBA's internal structures is checked against the new ones in the same commit, which says so.
